name: paper-collage
title: Paper collage
summary: Pieces of paper land on a cream sheet: cut-out photos with white borders, torn clippings, red stamps and typed labels, cut against dark b-roll under a halftone screen.

look.ground: cream paper sheet for paper scenes; b-roll for the others
look.type: Anton capitals for names and numbers; Special Elite for typed labels; Inter for captions
look.texture: paper grain over everything; b-roll desaturated to 35 %, contrast 1.18, brightness 0.7, 8 px halftone dots, soft vignette
look.light: flat on paper; whatever the b-roll has, crushed dark
look.materials: paper: torn edges, white sticker borders, drop shadows 0 6px 18px at low opacity

consistency: real photos of real people and places, cut out once and reused; nothing generated that shows a person

moves: slap: from 1.3-1.7x and +7 deg to 1x in 0.32 s, back.out(2.2)
rise: from below the frame and -6 deg in 0.5 s, expo.out
drop: from 120-180 px above, tilted, 0.5 s, back.out(1.5)
box stamp: 1.8x to 1x in 0.18 s, power4.in, multiplied at 0.92
every piece rests at -4 to +3 deg; every scene pushes 1.03-1.05x

pace.text: each piece lands on the word it belongs to; captions always on, a phrase at a time

banned: generated people, or AI-altered photos of real people
source: original, after the paper-collage look common in news explainers
